media_item.focus_or_theme: Life after exoneration; Lack of support, compensation, and difficulties reintegrating into society.
media_item.summary_notes: Documentary focusing on the difficulties faced by exonerees after release, including psychological trauma, housing/employment challenges, and the lack of state compensation and support services. It implicitly calls for better post-exoneration support systems and compensation for the wrongly convicted.
